cues.speech: Two agents can share the same information. But does that mean they have the same authority?
cues.subtitle: Two agents can share the same information. But does that mean they have the same authority?

cues.speech: When different people delegate authority, the agents need to know whose approval a decision requires.
cues.subtitle: When different people delegate authority, the agents need to know whose approval a decision requires.

cues.speech: Culture-Fit is an open-source Human-in-the-Loop layer. It connects evidence, delegated authority, and human judgment when a decision needs it.
cues.subtitle: Culture-Fit is an open-source Human-in-the-Loop layer. It connects evidence, delegated authority, and human judgment when a decision needs it.

cues.speech: Try it in your browser, or download the source and run it in your own environment.
cues.subtitle: Try it in your browser, or download the source and run it in your own environment.

cues.speech: Download and extract the source ZIP. Use uv to prepare the Python environment.
cues.subtitle: Download and extract the source ZIP. Use uv to prepare the Python environment.

cues.speech: Choose your operating system in the setup guide. On Mac, use the shell script. On Windows, use the PowerShell command.
cues.subtitle: Choose your operating system in the setup guide. On Mac, use the shell script. On Windows, use the PowerShell command.

cues.speech: If you use OpenClaw, download the Skill ZIP and configure it to connect to your running Culture-Fit server.
cues.subtitle: If you use OpenClaw, download the Skill ZIP and configure it to connect to your running Culture-Fit server.

cues.speech: The interface is in English. Conversation analysis supports both English and Korean.
cues.subtitle: The interface is in English. Conversation analysis supports both English and Korean.

cues.speech: From the workspace, import a conversation or explore a prepared example that needs a decision.
cues.subtitle: From the workspace, import a conversation or explore a prepared example that needs a decision.

cues.speech: Here, Release Agent and Review Agent both have approval grants for the same release.
cues.subtitle: Here, Release Agent and Review Agent both have approval grants for the same release.

cues.speech: Their grants come from different owners. The decision owner is still unknown.
cues.subtitle: Their grants come from different owners. The decision owner is still unknown.

cues.speech: The decision brief brings together agreements, open questions, and points that need human judgment.
cues.subtitle: The decision brief brings together agreements, open questions, and points that need human judgment.

cues.speech: Select a source reference to read the original message, and check what was actually said.
cues.subtitle: Select a source reference to read the original message, and check what was actually said.

cues.speech: Now, put Review Agent first in the proposed priority order.
cues.subtitle: Now, put Review Agent first in the proposed priority order.

cues.speech: With only one owner’s approval recorded, the other owner’s approval is still required.
cues.subtitle: With only one owner’s approval recorded, the other owner’s approval is still required.

cues.speech: Record both owners’ agreement, then save the priority order for this decision.
cues.subtitle: Record both owners’ agreement, then save the priority order for this decision.

cues.speech: After the authority check updates, Review Agent appears as the decision owner. It is clear who can proceed.
cues.subtitle: After the authority check updates, Review Agent appears as the decision owner. It is clear who can proceed.

cues.speech: This decision applies to approval of this release. Other actions are checked against their own scope and authority.
cues.subtitle: This decision applies to approval of this release. Other actions are checked against their own scope and authority.

cues.speech: In your own installation, agents can use MCP to report conversations and query next actions and authority.
cues.subtitle: In your own installation, agents can use MCP to report conversations and query next actions and authority.

cues.speech: A2A and Skill interfaces offer additional ways to connect the agent environments you use.
cues.subtitle: A2A and Skill interfaces offer additional ways to connect the agent environments you use.

cues.speech: Culture-Fit is MIT-licensed open source, built for developers everywhere to adapt and connect.
cues.subtitle: Culture-Fit is MIT-licensed open source, built for developers everywhere to adapt and connect.

cues.speech: The right person, at the right moment. Try Culture-Fit for yourself.
cues.subtitle: The right person, at the right moment. Try Culture-Fit for yourself.
